description: Defines the AOS_InvoicesViewDetail class for invoice detail view, including methods for displaying invoice templates and popup HTML in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: AOS_InvoicesViewDetail
classes.description: View class for invoice detail page, handling template population and popup display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays invoice details, populates templates, and shows popup HTML.

methods.name: populateInvoiceTemplates
methods.description: Fetches active invoice templates from database and populates a global list.

methods.name: displayPopupHtml
methods.description: Outputs HTML and JavaScript for invoice template selection popup.
